title: Checking the segment to server group to connector chain
aliases: connector group has no connected connectors
app segment server group app connector group chain

prose.text: The chain runs from the application segment to its server groups, to their App Connector groups, to connected App Connectors.

prose.label: Hops one and two.
prose.text: {{segment-lists-server-groups}} {{server-group-lists-connector-groups}} Whether an empty connector list can exist is open [[zpa.server-groups.connector-binding:empty-connector-group-rejected]].

prose.label: Hop three and the status field.
Beyond the chain.
prose.text: [[zpa.server-groups.connector-binding:no-connector-available]] A segment in one microtenant using a server group from another is unconfirmed {{gap:cross-microtenant-server-group}}.
Why a group may have no connector list is in [[zpa.server-groups.connector-binding]]; the segment-to-server-group relationship is in [[zpa.server-groups.role]].

checks.do: Find the application segment for the destination and port and read its serverGroups list; an empty list ends the chain at the segment.
For each server group id on the segment, read the server group's appConnectorGroups list; an empty list ends the chain at the server group.

For each connector group id, list the App Connectors whose appConnectorGroupId matches it and read their controlChannelStatus; ZPN_STATUS_AUTHENTICATED is the healthy value. Do not filter on connectionStatus, which no source defines.
Treat connector status as live state: it comes from a live read, and an IaC export taken earlier may not carry it.
If every hop passes, move on to reachability of the backend and to the policy side rather than to the server group.
If the tenant uses microtenants, read each object within its own microtenant and flag a segment whose server group is in another one.

segment-lists-server-groups.statement: An application segment carries its server groups in a `serverGroups` list.

server-group-lists-connector-groups.statement: A server group carries its App Connector groups in an `appConnectorGroups` list.

connector-group-id-field.statement: An App Connector carries the id of its group in `appConnectorGroupId`.

quotes: self.app_connector_group_id = config["appConnectorGroupId"] if "appConnectorGroupId" in config else None

connector-status-field.statement: An App Connector's control channel state is read from `controlChannelStatus` in the Python model; the OpenAPI connector object has `controlChannelStatus` with the values UNKNOWN, ZPN_STATUS_AUTHENTICATED and ZPN_STATUS_DISCONNECTED, and its nested `assistantVersion` object names the control channel status `ctrlChannelStatus` with the same values.

quotes: self.control_channel_status = config["controlChannelStatus"] if "controlChannelStatus" in config else None

expect.description: The status of the control channel.

connector-status-field.conditions: Corrected because the OpenAPI connector object also has a top-level controlChannelStatus, and ctrlChannelStatus sits in the nested assistantVersion object; previously "An App Connector's control channel state is read from `controlChannelStatus` in the Python model, and the OpenAPI document names the same status `ctrlChannelStatus` with the values UNKNOWN, ZPN_STATUS_AUTHENTICATED and ZPN_STATUS_DISCONNECTED."

no-connection-status-member.statement: No `connectionStatus` member is defined for an App Connector in the Python SDK, the Go SDK or the OpenAPI document; the status members are the control channel ones.
no-connection-status-member.conditions: Absence claim. Searched with `grep -rn connectionStatus` over zscaler/zpa in the Python SDK and in the Go SDK's zscaler/zpa at the pins and `grep -c connectionStatus` over the captured zpa.openapi.json: no hits in any of them.

cross-microtenant-server-group.title: Whether a segment in one microtenant can use a server group in another
cross-microtenant-server-group.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "A segment in microtenant A with a server group in microtenant B is a config error worth flagging." The microtenant article says the target segment group and server group must be configured before moving a segment, which implies the pair is per microtenant, but it does not say what the API does with a mismatch.

quotes: The target segment group and server group associated to the application segment must be configured.
